## EmuTrim 0.6.1

### Highlights

- Added `clear` for safely removing EmuTrim-managed AVDs.
- Added `clear all` for removing all managed AVDs while preserving the managed SDK and system images.
- Named and all-target clear runs are dry-run by default; `--yes` is required for deletion.
- Bare `clear` provides an interactive managed-only selector.
- Running emulators are refused and must be stopped explicitly first.
- Added strict managed manifest, path-containment, symlink/reparse, and all-target preflight checks.
- Added retry-safe behavior for partial filesystem or manifest-update failures.

### Safety

`clear` only operates on positively verified EmuTrim-managed AVDs. External Android Studio AVDs are not supported for deletion.

`clear all` is intentionally narrower than `managed clean --yes`: it preserves the managed SDK, emulator, tools, and system images.

### Platforms

- Windows x86_64
- Apple Silicon macOS arm64

### Known limitations

- Physical multi-AVD `clear all` acceptance was not performed; multi-target preflight and zero-delete failure behavior are covered by automated tests.
- macOS `stats` remains unsupported.
- Linux remains CI/core-only.
- External AVD deletion and reset/wipe-data are not included.
